name: FP&A Operations
tagline: Turning production, site cost and logistics data into plans and actuals that steer operations.
pickerIntro: Four processes covering planning and actual close for source-to-manufacture and warehouse and distribution finance.

context.label: Solutions
context.text: Documented solutions are dashboards: APAC Volume & COGM @ Standard, APAC PPV and APAC Site Cost & FTE dashboards for manufacturing actuals, a Global Logistic Finance Dashboard that supports closing with a planning comparative, and a Zuellig Pharma Volume Analysis Dashboard still in progress.

context.label: Automation
context.text: The actuals processes list Python, Power BI and Nintex alongside Hyperion, SAP, Coupa, Workday, CoStar and the Office tools; planning adds Capex Tool and AZForce and produces a Hyperion loading template. The source does not describe individual automated routines.

context.label: AI
context.text: Two commentary agents are documented as TPI solutions: Agent Charlie consolidates and summarises APAC commentaries for Source to Manufacture planning, and Agent Rhy does the same for Source to Manufacture actuals.

context.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
context.text: Inputs come from GSC, HR, Embedded Finance, PET, GERE, Global IT and Quality, Procurement, Product Costing, Distribution and Logistics leads, and the R2R, P2P and payroll teams; outputs go to Embedded Finance, GFS Ops FP&A, Global Ops Reporting and the logistics heads.

processes.title: Source to Manufacture - Planning
processes.purpose:
Source to Manufacture - Planning calculates and simulates the manufacturing P&L for the planning cycle. GFS Ops brings together production volume and inventory inputs from Global Supply Chain, manpower and FTE inputs from HR and Embedded Finance, non-manpower costs from the Departmental Heads, capex from GERE, the Site Project Managers, Global IT, Global Quality and EF, standard costing (FMC and SCC) from Global Product Costing, targets and productivity from Global Ops, and lease information from R2R Lease and Embedded Finance.

The work covers inventory and capacity planning, resources planning (material, manpower, non-manpower, depreciation and amortisation, capex and productivity) and the annual full manufacturing costs. It produces the loading template, planning deck, P&L results, draft commentaries and the FMC sign-off dashboard, which feed Embedded Finance and the Operation Business, GFS Ops FP&A and Global Ops Reporting.

stages.title: Finalise planning production volumes
stages.detail: Calculate and Simulate P&L: Inventory and capacity planning: Planning production volume finalised (GSC)
stages.description: Confirm the finalised planning production volume supplied by Global Supply Chain - Network Supply (GSC). This is the manufacturing input that opens the inventory and capacity planning block of the P&L calculation and simulation.
challenges: Multiple streams of information feeds create consolidation effort and waiting time.
Stretched timeline.
Incomplete information creates back-and-forth communication.
stages.challengeScope: Process-wide challenge; the source does not assign it to an individual step.

stages.title: Finalise inventory balances
stages.detail: Inventory balance finalised (GSC)
stages.description: Confirm the finalised inventory balance using the inventory volume and NPI provision supplied by Global Supply Chain - Inventory (GSC).

stages.title: Plan the inventory and write-off provision
stages.displayTitle: Plan the inventory and write-off provision
stages.detail: Provision for inventory/write off
stages.description: Plan the provision for inventory and write-off as the last element of inventory and capacity planning, drawing on the inventory volume and NPI provision received from GSC. The source does not describe the provisioning method.

stages.title: Plan material costs at standard yield and PPV
stages.displayTitle: Plan material costs at standard yield and PPV
stages.detail: Resources planning: Material: Cost of Goods Manufacture at Standard Yield, Purchase Price Variances
stages.description: Open the resources planning block by planning material cost: Cost of Goods Manufacture at standard yield and purchase price variances. This draws on the standard costing inputs, FMC and SCC, supplied by Global Product Costing (PC).

stages.title: Plan FTE, manpower and manpower-driven costs
stages.displayTitle: Plan FTE, manpower and manpower-driven costs
stages.detail: FTE & Manpower and manpower driven cost planning
stages.description:
Plan FTE and manpower, and the costs driven by manpower, using the manpower and related cost inputs from HR and the FTE inputs from HR and Embedded Finance (EF).

HR provides its input through AZForce; EF reviews it and GFS makes the adjustments, so this step waits on each party in turn.
challenges: Collaboration increases waiting time, e.g. AZForce input from HR, review by EF and adjustment by GFS; Global IT and Global Quality delays on recharge communication block depreciation finalisation and impact P&L finalisation.

stages.title: Plan non-manpower costs and simulate D&A
stages.displayTitle: Plan non-manpower costs and simulate D&A
stages.detail: Non-manpower cost planning, including depreciation and amortisation simulation and calculation
stages.description:
Plan non-manpower costs using the non-manpower related cost inputs from the Departmental Heads and EF, including the simulation and calculation of depreciation and amortisation. Lease inputs from R2R Lease and Embedded Finance also form part of the planning inputs.

Depreciation finalisation depends on recharge communication from Global IT and Global Quality.
challenges: Collaboration increases waiting time, e.g. AZForce input from HR, review by EF and adjustment by GFS; Global IT and Global Quality delays on recharge communication block depreciation finalisation and impact P&L finalisation.

stages.title: Plan capex for new and in-flight projects
stages.displayTitle: Plan capex for new and in-flight projects
stages.detail: Capex planning: new flight and inflight
stages.description: Plan capital expenditure for new-flight and in-flight projects, using the capex inputs supplied by GERE, the Site Project Managers, Global IT, Global Quality and EF.

stages.title: Track productivity
stages.detail: Productivity tracking (EF, Procurements, PET)
stages.description: Track productivity with Embedded Finance, Procurement and Production (PET), against the target and productivity inputs supplied by Global Ops.

stages.title: Compile annual full manufacturing costs
stages.detail: Annual Full Manufacturing costs
stages.description:
Bring the planning blocks together into the annual full manufacturing costs and the calculated and simulated P&L.

The outputs are the loading template, planning deck, P&L results, draft commentaries and the FMC sign-off dashboard. They feed Embedded Finance and the Operation Business, GFS Ops FP&A and Global Ops Reporting.

Across the process GFS Ops works in Hyperion, Capex Tool, AZForce, SAP, CoStar, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint.
challenges: Multiple systems create reconciliation effort.
Rework due to changes and global direction.
Actualisation information in the system took 8 working days.
System issues (missing data, inaccurate data, current flow not supporting process change, etc.).

processes.title: Source to Manufacture - Actual
processes.purpose:
Source to Manufacture - Actual supports the month-end close for manufacturing sites and reviews the actual results. GFS Ops monitors and reviews production volume and Cost of Goods Manufacture at standard, FTE and site and quality cost, inventory provisioning and capex spending, using inputs from Production (PET), R2R (including R2R Capex, R2R Lease and R2R ICT), P2P, T&E, CnB, Controlling, Embedded Finance, Site Quality, HR and Payroll/People Services.

The close work runs from sub-module, MM and SAP close through system-to-system reconciliation, material adjustment review, P&L and balance sheet review and sign-off, controls attestation, recharges, productivity and KPIs. It produces the volume and COGM report, FTE and site and quality cost report, inventory provision, capex spend report, MI pack, P&L results and draft commentaries for Embedded Finance and the Operation Business, GFS Ops FP&A and Global Ops Reporting.

stages.title: Close the FA, AP and AR sub-modules
stages.displayTitle: Close the FA, AP and AR sub-modules
stages.detail: Sub-module close: FA, AP, AR
stages.description:
Support the sub-module close for fixed assets, accounts payable and accounts receivable. This consumes the AP cut-off for Coupa PO and non-PO invoices and the T&E cut-off from P2P, bank clearing from CnB, the depreciation and amortisation run from R2R Capex and the lease amortisation run from R2R Lease.

Capex spending is monitored and reviewed alongside the fixed asset close: opex-to-capex reclassification (consumption from process orders and NTI recharge), capex spending GR/IR from Coupa POs and VoWD accruals.
challenges: Late posting from upstream.

stages.title: Support intra-month checks and MM close
stages.displayTitle: Support intra-month checks and MM close
stages.detail: MM close: support on intra-month check and MM close co-ordination
stages.description: Support the intra-month check and coordinate the materials management (MM) close. The inputs are the completion of process orders and the material movement cut-off from Production (PET), together with the consumption of spares; these underpin the monitoring and review of production volume and COGM at standard.

stages.title: Support SAP close with non-judgemental journals
stages.displayTitle: Support SAP close with non-judgemental journals
stages.detail: SAP close: support on non-judgemental journals
stages.description: Support the SAP close by preparing the non-judgemental journals. The inputs at this point are the Workday (HR) cut-off and payroll posting from HR, Payroll/People Services and R2R, the intercompany recharge, and the month-end close accruals from R2R and P2P, which feed the monitoring and review of FTE and site and quality cost.

stages.title: Reconcile data across systems
stages.detail: System-to-system reconciliation
stages.description: Reconcile system to system so that the close data ties across SAP, SOAR, FDH and ASO.
challenges: Multiple systems create reconciliation effort (SAP-SOAR-FDH-ASO).

stages.title: Review and monitor material adjustments
stages.detail: Material adjustment review & monitoring: PPV, WIP, TP change, duty true up
stages.description: Review and monitor the material adjustments: purchase price variance (PPV), work in progress (WIP), transfer price changes and duty true-up.

stages.title: Review P&L results and obtain EF sign-off
stages.displayTitle: Review P&L results and obtain EF sign-off
stages.detail: P&L results (including material variance assessment), review and sign off by EF
stages.description:
Prepare the P&L results, including the material variance assessment, for review and sign-off by Embedded Finance.

The inventory provision proposed by GFS Ops is also reviewed at this point, with input and review from EF.

stages.title: Review and sign off the balance sheet
stages.displayTitle: Review and sign off the balance sheet
stages.detail: Balance Sheet review and sign-off
stages.description: Review the balance sheet and obtain sign-off.

stages.title: Complete controls attestation and sign-off
stages.detail: Controls attestation and sign off
stages.description: Attest the controls for the period and obtain sign-off.

stages.title: Process NTI and COBOU recharges
stages.detail: Recharges (NTI and COBOU)
stages.description: Process the NTI and COBOU recharges.

stages.title: Report productivity
stages.detail: Productivity
stages.description: Report productivity for the period. The source lists productivity as a step without further detail.

stages.title: Report KPIs and issue the MI pack
stages.displayTitle: Report KPIs and issue the MI pack
stages.detail: KPIs (Cost per unit, Output per FTE)
stages.description:
Report the KPIs: cost per unit and output per FTE.

The outputs of the close are the volume and COGM report, the FTE and site and quality cost report, the inventory provision, the capex spend report, the MI pack, the P&L results and the draft commentaries. They feed Embedded Finance and the Operation Business, GFS Ops FP&A and Global Ops Reporting.

Across the process GFS Ops works in Hyperion, SAP, CoStar, Coupa, Nintex, OneGRC, Python, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Workday, Utmost and SharePoint.
challenges: System issues (missing data, inaccurate data, current flow not supporting process change, etc.).
